title: Configuring Your Zoho MCP Server
snippet:
The Zoho MCP service is for anyone who needs to optimize and automate their operations workflow. There is no restriction or prior programming language required to use this service to its fullest potential.

To configure your Zoho MCP server:
1. Navigate to the **Zoho MCP console**. ([mcp.zoho.com](https://mcp.zoho.com/mcp-client#))
2. Provide a name for your Zoho MCP server and click **Create Server**.
![Naming Zoho MCP server](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/naming-a-mcp-server.png)
3. The Zoho MCP Server will be created. Click the **Configure Tools** button to configure the required tools
4. Choose **Zoho Cliq**.
![Zoho Cliq tool in Zoho MCP Server](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/zoho-cliq-in-mcp-product-list.png)
5. You will be presented with a list of tools. These tools provide the appropriate context and access to perform the required actions instructed in the prompt. You can also search for your required tools using the search-bar.
![Choose list of tools from Zoho Cliq](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/images/choose_cliq_tools.gif)
6. Click **Add Now**, once you have selected the required tools.
7. All the required tools will be added to your Zoho MCP server.

A unique and secure URL will be generated by the Zoho MCP service each time you create a Zoho MCP server. This MCP URL will serve as the endpoint invoked when a prompt is executed from your MCP Client.
![Setting up MCP URL](https://www.zohowebstatic.com/sites/zweb/images/cliq/mcp-url.png)
To copy the MCP URL:
1. Click the **Connect** tab in the sidebar.
2. Click the copy button next to the URL to copy it.
Now you can use this URL to integrate your Zoho MCP server with your MCP Client. Additionally, you can also click the **API Key Re-Generate** button to generate a new MCP URL endpoint to invoke your Zoho MCP server.

title: Bring AI into your workflow with Zoho Cliq’s Model Context Protocol (MCP)
snippet:
With Zoho Cliq's Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI in Cliq goes beyond conversation by letting your AI agent take action across Cliq, Zoho apps and beyond, not just chat.
MCP is a standardized bridge between AI agents (like Claude, Windsurf, VS Code) and Cliq, layered on top of your data, apps, and actions - so you can say what you need in plain language, and watch it happen instantly

The Cliq MCP Server exposes Cliq's core capabilities as standardized tools, so MCP-compatible AI clients can read context, take action, and coordinate work across Zoho and third-party systems.

### Understand what's happening
AI reads your workspace, not just messages.
Cliq MCP gives AI access to channels, threads, users, roles, and past conversations — so it understands context, ownership, and decisions.
### Coordinate teams in real time
AI can organize people, not just data.
Create channels, route updates, notify the right teams, and respect org structure automatically.
### Monitor and surface what matters
Important signals reach you before you look for them.
AI monitors connected systems and brings critical updates into Cliq, where teams already work
### Retrieve context instantly
Ask once. Get the exact answer.
Find messages, files, records, or past decisions across your workspace — without searching manually.
## Works with your AI environment
Zoho Cliq MCP is completely model-agnostic. It doesn't connect to or depend on any specific LLM.
Instead, it exposes a standardized interface that any AI agent, powered by any LLM, can call through an MCP client.
Whether you're using GPT, Claude, a fine-tuned model, or an open-source LLM, as long as your agent speaks the MCP protocol, it can securely access tools, actions, and data across your Zoho apps.

Zoho Cliq's MCP follows Zoho's enterprise-grade security protocols. All data access and agent actions are governed by strict access controls, encrypted data handling, and audit trails, ensuring safe, compliant execution.
### Authentication & Authorization
Agents operate under user-level permissions and supports OAuth to ensure secure identity management.
### Rate Limiting
Throttling protects systems while ensuring smooth operation.
### Observability & Audit
Complete audit trails. Monitor usage, track changes, maintain compliance.

title: Guide to Zoho Cliq's MCP Server
snippet:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that establishes the standardized way applications can interact with Large Language Models (LLMs). An MCP allows you to carry out your desired workflow on your preferred LLMs by providing the instructions to an AI model in the proper context.
With an MCP, you can instruct popular AI agents, or even custom AI agents, to interact with native or third-party applications and complete complex workflows with little to no human intervention.
### **Zoho Cliq MCP Server**
The Zoho Cliq MCP Server brings your chats into the world of AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This open protocol defines how AI agents can connect to real-world tools and data sources in a structured, predictable way.
The following diagram will provide you with an overview of what Zoho MCP will allow your AI agents to achieve:

Any AI model or agent can use our official MCP server to access your Cliq data and do:
- **More work, less chat**: Send quick messages to colleagues or groups with prompts like, "Post a product launch announcement in the #marketing-updates channel" or "Schedule a message about the agenda of the competitor campaign to the brand strategy group chat."
- **Never miss a beat**: Set reminders for yourself or others, such as "Alert the product team to test the beta by Wednesday" or "Cue the sales lead for the client pitch tomorrow," and adjust or reassign them as needed when work shifts.
- **Organize your chats**: Create channels on the fly for new projects, archive old ones like "Last Year's Audit" to stay current, and moderate your channels by deleting messages, viewing participants, or updating details.
- **Have focused discussions**: Start targeted threads like "Q4 Strategy 2026" and invite others to join or auto-follow all threads in a channel effortlessly.
